content: सान्दीपनिः <ab>N.</ab> of a sage. [According to ViṣṇuPurāṇa, he was the tutor of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, and asked as his preceptorʼs fee that his son, who was kept by a demon named Pañchajana underneath the waters, should be restored to him. Kṛṣṇa, having undertaken to get him up, plunged into the sea, killed the demon, and brought back the boy to his father.]
